description: This file defines the 'Playback' class which implements local media playback functionality using Android's MediaPlayer API. It manages media playback states, audio focus, resource management, and handles media events such as preparation, completion, errors, and seeking. The class interacts with a MusicService, handles resource locking, and responds to system events like noisy audio outputs.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: Implements local media playback leveraging MediaPlayer, managing states, resources, and system events for audio playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes or starts playback; implementation is currently empty.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, releases resources, and optionally notifies listeners.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Indicates if playback is connected; always returns true.

methods.name: isPlaying
methods.description: Checks if media is currently playing.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Prepares and starts playing a media item, handling resource management and media source setup.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback and releases resources accordingly.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for playback events.
